newsitem.title: SWEDEN: No revision of Swedish budget despite yield claim.
newsitem.headline: No revision of Swedish budget despite yield claim.

text.p: Sweden's Finance Ministry said on Wednesday it had no plans to revise the supplementary budget released last week, despite a newspaper report saying the wrong bond yields were used in calculations.
The daily business newspaper Finanstidningen said the government had used the wrong yields to calculate the budget.
"There were no wrong calculations and there are no plans to revise this," ministry spokeswoman Maja Nilsson told Reuters.
Finanstidningen said the government had used the four year bond yield in its calculations instead of the five year bond yield that is higher.
This miscalcuation left the budget about 1.5 billion crowns short, according to the newspaper.
At midday on Wednesday, the four year bond yield was 5.97 percent and the five year yield 6.33 percent.
